neighbours.label: The word 'frequently' before a past participle (most frequently asked, seen) and the subject in 'the questions X asked'; other adverbs and subjects read low
fire: Here are some of the most frequently asked questions about visas.
This page covers frequently requested topics from our readers.
The questions students asked grew harder every week.
Below are answers to frequently-asked questions on billing.
It is among the most frequently cited papers in the field.
The questions parents asked surprised the young teacher.
These are the most frequently used commands in Linux.
The questions reporters asked were sharp and direct.
quiet: Here are some of the most beautiful old churches in Spain.
This page covers recently published books from our readers.
The games students played grew harder every week.
Below are answers to the crossword on the back page.
It is among the most expensive hotels in the city.
The songs parents sang surprised the young teacher.
These are the most comfortable chairs in the office.
The photos reporters took were sharp and clear.

notes: 'frequently seen' read as high as 'frequently asked' (0.87), so the word matters more than asking. The other pole suppresses ask, asked.
